one_liner: Doc-based platform blending documents, spreadsheets, and apps (now rebranded as Superhuman Docs).

auth.notes: Product renamed: Coda was acquired by Grammarly (Dec 2024), Grammarly rebranded as Superhuman (Oct 2025), and Coda became 'Superhuman Docs' (Jul 2026). Its developer docs URL (coda.io/developers/apis/v1) now redirects to docs.superhuman.com/developers/apis/v1. Historically Coda's API used a bearer API token and had no public OAuth2 app flow, but this was not re-confirmed on the new docs domain within the 4-call budget.

access.notes: Could not confirm current free-tier/API access terms under the new Superhuman Docs branding within budget.

api.notes: Docs root confirmed via redirect only (307 from coda.io/developers/apis/v1); no page content was successfully fetched from the new domain within budget.

verdict.rationale: Product was renamed to Superhuman Docs during a corporate rebrand; the new docs domain needs a dedicated pass to re-verify auth, access tier, and API details.
